story: The Barn Owl (Tyto alba) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Tytonidae family. It is most commonly observed in Open habitats: grasslands; deserts; marshes; agricultural fields; and farmlands, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Barn Owl is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Barn Owl into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
